# A well pump in your house

## When the pump runs

<!-- S1.e1 -->
A family opens a tap and wants the water to come at once. For this, the pump has a *pressure switch*, one sensor per tank. Only that switch decides when the pump starts and when it stops again.

<!-- S1.e2 -->
![The path of the water](fig1.png)

<!-- S1.e3 -->
The pump must not lose its water when it stops. The *check valve*, a part that holds the water, keeps it primed.

## Settings that protect the pump

### Low water cutoff

<!-- S2.1.e1 -->
A low water cutoff stops the pump when the well runs low. An owner can turn the cutoff off for a deep well that never runs dry in summer.

### Pressure limits

<!-- S2.2.e1 -->
Four people decide who may change the limits.

- Owners change the pump's settings.
- Plumbers fit parts unless changes are blocked.
- Guests change nothing.
- Owners decide who counts as a plumber.
